tsa-a15-v01.quick_english: When again, near death, a power-descent arises of himself or through a kinsman's mouth — then for him immediately perform the exit-initiation.

tsa-a15-v02.quick_english: Having placed the whole path in the disciple and purified him in order, and placed the blessed Kālarātrī, the vein-cutter, by her, joint by joint — having split the vein-nooses, let him make the disciple's consciousness dwell at the brahmarandhra.

tsa-a15-v03.quick_english: Then, by the aforesaid order, let him give the full-offering for yojanā's sake — so that at the full-offering the departed soul becomes one with Paramaśiva.

tsa-a15-v04.quick_english: And for the desirer of enjoyment, the second full-offering.

tsa-a15-v05.quick_english: In the place of enjoyment, for yojanā, and at that time in his jīvalaya — no remaining-turning here. Or let one recite Brahma-knowledge in the ear: she, of parāmarśa-nature, instantly makes vimarśa awakened in the consciousness of the already-awakened paśu.

tsa-a15-v06.quick_english: Also in this recitation there is authority from samayya and the rest.

tsa-a15-v07.quick_english: But if he shows a with-conviction, seedless initiation to a fool and to one whose power-descent has come — then at Śiva-hand-giving-time this rite: contemplating in the right hand a triangular, āgneya, flame-terrible, repha-spark, outward-vāta-wheel-rolling mandala, casting a little seed therein in the hand itself, by the up-down repha-revealed phaṭkāra successions he burns her generative-power. Doing thus, he casts that hand onto the disciple's head. Thus for both this seedless initiation destroys the capacity for doing one's own work — because even inanimate things are stated as initiatable. Let him contemplate the disciple installed inside the vāyupura, shaken, become-light — by which, by comparison, he is seen as light.

tsa-a15-v01.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v01.question: When is the exit-initiation performed?
premises: Near death, a power-descent arises — of himself or through a kinsman's mouth.
Then for him immediately the samutkramaṇa-initiation is performed.
tsa-a15-v01.inference: Śaktipāta near death triggers the exit-initiation at once, whether it comes of oneself or through another's mouth.

tsa-a15-v02.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v02.question: What is done to the disciple before the full-offering?
premises: The whole path is placed in the disciple and he is purified in order.
Blessed Kālarātrī the vein-cutter is placed, joint by joint; the vein-nooses are split, and the disciple's consciousness is made dwell at the brahmarandhra.
tsa-a15-v02.inference: Nyāsa of the adhvan, ordered purification, and Kālarātrī's joint-by-joint vein-cutting move the disciple's caitanya to the brahmarandhra.

tsa-a15-v03.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v03.question: Why is the full-offering given, and with what result?
premises: By the aforesaid order the full-offering is given for yojanā's sake.
At the full-offering the departed soul goes out and becomes one with Paramaśiva.
tsa-a15-v03.inference: The pūrṇāhuti completes yojanā: the jīva, exiting, becomes abhinna with Paramaśiva.

tsa-a15-v04.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v04.question: Which full-offering comes for the enjoyer?
premises: For the desirer of enjoyment there is a second full-offering.
tsa-a15-v04.inference: A second pūrṇāhuti is reserved for the bubhukṣu — desire of bhoga gets its own oblation.

tsa-a15-v05.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v05.question: What if yojanā falls in the enjoyment-place — what rescues it?
premises: In the bhoga-sthāna for yojanā, at that time in his jīvalaya, no śeṣa-vartana remains.
Or Brahma-vidyā is recited in the ear: of parāmarśa-nature, she instantly awakens vimarśa in the already-awakened paśu-caitanya.
tsa-a15-v05.inference: No residual turning remains there; the alternative is aural Brahma-vidyā, whose parāmarśa-nature instantly makes vimarśa manifest in the paśu's awakened consciousness.

tsa-a15-v06.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v06.question: On what authority does the ear-recitation stand?
premises: Also in this recitation there is authority from samayya and the rest.
tsa-a15-v06.inference: The etat-pāṭha's adhikāra derives from samayya-ādi — the recitation is licensed, not invented.

tsa-a15-v07.speaker: Teacher (dīkṣā-vidhi)
tsa-a15-v07.question: What is the rite of the seedless initiation shown to a fool or a late-comer?
premises: To a fool and to one whose power-descent has come, a with-conviction seedless dīkṣā is shown; at Śiva-hand-giving-time this rite: a triangular āgneya mandala, flame-terrible, repha-spark, outward-vāta-wheel-rolling, contemplated in the right hand, a little seed cast therein, burnt by phaṭkāra-successions of up-down repha.
Doing thus, the hand is cast onto the disciple's head; for both, this seedless initiation destroys the capacity for doing one's own work — since even inanimate things are stated initiatable.
The disciple is contemplated installed inside the vāyupura, shaken and become-light — by which, compared, he is seen light.
tsa-a15-v07.inference: The nirbījā dīkṣā works palm-mandala → seed-burning by phaṭkāras → hand-on-head, destroying svakārya-karaṇa-sāmarthya; even sthāvara qualify, and the light-comparison confirms the disciple's laghūbhāva.

essence: The exit-initiation is performed at once when power-descent comes near death — of oneself or through a kinsman's mouth.
The whole path placed in the disciple, Kālarātrī cuts the vein-nooses joint by joint until the disciple's consciousness dwells at the brahmarandhra.
The full-offering for yojanā's sake: the departed soul goes out and becomes one with Paramaśiva.
For the desirer of enjoyment, the second full-offering.
No remaining-turning stands in the enjoyment-place; or Brahma-vidyā in the ear instantly awakens vimarśa in the awakened paśu's consciousness.
The ear-recitation's authority derives from samayya and the rest.

The seedless initiation to fool or late-comer: āgneya palm-mandala, seed burnt by phaṭkāra-successions, hand cast on the head — own-work-capacity destroyed, even inanimate initiatable; the disciple contemplated shaken and light within the vāyupura.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
rasa.sthayibhava: śama with vidhi (quiescence as ordered rite)
rasa.justification: The rites are stated in order — placement, offering, recitation, burning, install — with no rhetorical heat; the relish is procedure that works.

sections.SUMMARY: The exit-initiation is performed at once when power-descent comes near death — of oneself or through a kinsman's mouth. The whole path placed in the disciple, Kālarātrī cuts the vein-nooses joint by joint until the disciple's consciousness dwells at the brahmarandhra. The full-offering for yojanā's sake: the departed soul goes out and becomes one with Paramaśiva. For the desirer of enjoyment, the second full-offering. No remaining-turning stands in the enjoyment-place; or Brahma-vidyā in the ear instantly awakens vimarśa in the awakened paśu's consciousness. The ear-recitation's authority derives from samayya and the rest. The seedless initiation to fool or late-comer: āgneya palm-mandala, seed burnt by phaṭkāra-successions, hand cast on the head — own-work-capacity destroyed, even inanimate initiatable; the disciple contemplated shaken and light within the vāyupura.
sections.FUNCTION: Seals the near-death exit-initiation, completes yojanā by full-offering, licenses the ear-recitation, and performs the seedless initiation by palm-mandala and hand-on-head.
sections.KEY TERMS: samutkramaṇa-dīkṣā (exit-initiation at death); Kālarātrī (vein-cutting goddess); pūrṇāhuti (full-offering of yojanā); parāmarśa (ear-recitation's nature); nirbījā dīkṣā (seedless initiation); phaṭkāra (burning succession); vāyupura (the disciple's installed place).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Continues the initiation series: admission near death (v1), preparation (v2), the yojanā offering (v3-5), its license (v6), then the seedless rite for fool or late-comer (v7).
sections.BOUNDARY: The mandala's geometry and phaṭkāra sequence are stated as rite, not explained as theory; svakārya-sāmarthya's destruction is asserted, not argued.
sections.EXPLANATION: Because power-descent may come at the death-hour, the exit-initiation must be immediate; because the disciple's consciousness must stand at the brahmarandhra, Kālarātrī clears the veins jointwise; because yojanā ends in Paramaśiva, the full-offering completes it — or, in the bhoga-sthāna, ear-recitation awakens vimarśa by its own nature; because even sthāvara are initiatable, the seedless rite destroys the capacity for one's own work and installs the disciple light in the vāyupura.
sections.RELATED: Tantrasara a14-admission context (series); Pradipaka on dīkṣā grades — lore support, never witness; qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: near-death summons — the rite's trigger; FIRST unit: sets the house voice (vidhi-cadence, owner verdict required). Sanskrit-first: yadā punar condition kept; svayaṃ vā bandhumukhena double-source kept (self OR kinsman); sadyaḥ kept at-once.
